answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 55 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the quill challenge, the saffron audit can replay the oasis history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2744 identities would post 2650 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
